issues.detail: The Hebrew 'נְהַר כְּבָר' (the river Chebar) is rendered as '基伯城大河' (the great river of the city of Gibber/Kiber), which incorrectly adds '城' (city) and misrepresents the proper name 'Chebar' as '基伯' instead of a transliteration like '基伯河' or '迦巴魯河'. The Hebrew has no word for 'city' here.
